en: A vintage postcard view of an urban square with cobblestone streets and people in early 20th‑century clothing walking and standing around. Multi‑storey stone buildings frame the scene, with a prominent, lighter‑colored building in the background. The style is monochrome with light color tinting. Printed captions in Swedish identify the location and publisher, and there is a museum credit strip at the bottom.
